scope: Direct Standard GLB Core PBR factors for certified uniform independent source paint and effect-free layers.

proof.paint_footprint: Conservative triangle and bilinear support bounds; deduplicated actual padding owners; constant premultiplied overlay and coverage.
proof.source_material: Untreated images, settings and original UVs remain paired. Fully covered channels or constant source channels can become factors. Shared ORM keeps its unaffected channel.

actual_gpu: Intel Arc A770 hardware EGL and oneAPI Release

asan_ubsan.mode: headless CPU reference and software EGL consumer

refusals: Spatially varying contributions, combinations of partial paint with varying source samples and nonzero additions, and unsupported typed or baked contributions retain the explicit portable export requirement.
open: General alternate-UV Standard GLB paint export remains incomplete.
